value.rationale: The result identifies a concrete failure mode in a recent deformation-theory criterion: nonzero local deformation support and nonzero twisted global sections do not force an untwisted global first-order deformation of the projective scheme. The example is useful for separating local deformation directions from globalizable ones and is stronger than a routine restatement of the normal-crossing T^1 formula.
